profile.legalName: Synopsys Silicon Valley Science & Technology Outreach Foundation
profile.summary: A nonprofit that works with Bay Area schools and community partners to support science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) learning for students in kindergarten through 12th grade. Its programs include science fair support, classroom STEM resources and teacher events. It says it reaches about 150,000 students and teachers each year across California.

review.notes: Identity is correct (ProPublica legal name and EIN 77-0520414 match the agenda name, Los Gatos mailing address, K-12 STEM nonprofit), but the summary claims 'science fair support' as a program, which neither cited source nor the foundation's homepage or sciencepalooza page mentions (programs listed are Building STEM Classrooms, STEM Opportunity Fund, Teachers & Tacos, Spring into STEM, sciencepalooza). The summary also says 'works with Bay Area schools and community partners' without direct support. Reject the summary as written; a corrected summary limited to the sourced programs would be publishable.
